mapper.select: SELECT * FROM npc_profile WHERE id=#{npcId} AND scope_type=#{scopeType} AND scope_type IN (2,4) AND scope_id=#{scopeId} AND del_flag='0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM npc_voice_enrollment_intent WHERE npc_id=#{npcId} AND sample_sha256=#{sampleSha256} AND request_id=CONCAT('sample:',#{sampleSha256}) FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM npc_voice_enrollment_intent WHERE npc_id=#{npcId} AND state IN ('IN_FLIGHT','UNKNOWN') ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM npc_voice_enrollment_intent WHERE npc_id=#{npcId} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM npc_voice_enrollment_intent WHERE npc_id=#{npcId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM npc_voice_enrollment_intent WHERE npc_id=#{npcId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM npc_voice_enrollment_intent WHERE npc_id=#{npcId} AND actor_member_id=#{actorMemberId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE npc_voice_enrollment_intent SET state='IN_FLIGHT',updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND state='PREPARED'

UPDATE npc_voice_enrollment_intent SET state=#{state},voice_id=#{voiceId},reason_code=#{reasonCode}, profile_version=#{profileVersion},updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND npc_id=#{npcId} AND scope_type=#{scopeType} AND scope_id=#{scopeId} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND sample_sha256=#{sampleSha256} AND state IN ('IN_FLIGHT','UNKNOWN','PENDING','READY','NOT_SENT')
